Women are always complaining about the mental load they carry as mothers. They have to keep track of the kids’ schedule, laundry, cooking, doctor’s appointments. They won’t hesitate to tell you how stressful it is. In this sketch, you’ll hear from a father who’s completely oblivious to the mental load that he carries, which only involves keeping the whole family alive, fed, sheltered, protected, and raised with good values to keep the kids from having their lives fall apart down the road as adults.
